description.en: Adds a numbered attribute (e.g. a terrain effect ID) to a floor zone previously registered with CMND_BTL_REGIST_FLOOR_ATTR.
Name of the floor zone (as registered with CMND_BTL_REGIST_FLOOR_ATTR).
Attribute ID to add to the zone.
True once the attribute has been added to the zone; null if fewer than 2 arguments were given.
